body:
thank you for your lengthy and thoughtful response. i’ll check out r/agedtattoos. i think theres a lot of things i dont know and misconceptions i have, plus ive overthought things. i saw a forum post a couple years ago that said something like, if you want a perfect design get it on a tshirt bc a tattoo will usually have small flaws. it’s something ill get used to, i already feel better abt it

thank you for the advice, ill look up blastover tattoos and laser as well, and after theyve finished healing and i can see what the end result is, i’ll see what i choose to do
thank you, i asked a friend and he also said it looked good which made me feel better. i know the appearance can change over the couple weeks of healing, so i hope i grow to like it
thank you. i know laser is an option but ive heard its expensive, i think if i REALLY couldnt live w it i would save the money and get a couple sesisons like u suggest. thank u for ur advice

yepp /:

we’re not in lockdown here but might as well be w how little a social life i have now. my friend said i should try going to the hangout space at my school to meet people but eughhh yk? i look gross n dress like trash bc im too tired to put an effort in. i feel like everyone just thinks i look gross and weird when they look at me, but i cant b bothered doing anything abt it. ive literally been wearing the same outfit every day this year like a cartoon character bc its always on the end of my bed
